Their goal is to eliminate the use of single-use glass packaging. Problem Environmental challenges : The spirits industry faces significant environmental concerns, particularly from single-use glass bottles, which accumulate in landfills. High costs : Single-use packaging and highly inefficient logistics account for up to 70% of the costs of distillers and beverage operators, impacting their profitability. Solution ecoSPIRITS has developed a sustainable, closed-loop distribution solution that aims to cut single-use packaging waste from the spirits and wine industry by 95%, reducing its carbon footprint. Key components include: EcoTOTE : A reusable, tamper-proof container that replaces traditional glass bottles. EcoPLANT : A facility that sanitises, refills, and reseals empty EcoTOTEs. Growsari - Wavemaker Ventures Skip to main content Wavemaker Ventures Get in touch About Our Investment Thesis Our Partnership Approach Sustainability Wavemaker Partners Our Portfolio Our Team News and Insights Contact Menu About Our Investment Thesis Our Partnership Approach Sustainability Wavemaker Partners Our Portfolio Our Team News and Insights Contact Get in touch Portfolio / Growsari Growsari is an online platform that connects sari-sari stores (mom-and-pops) directly to manufacturers, allowing store owners to double their product margins compared to the traditional supply chain. Problem Vital yet underserved stores : There are 1 million sari-sari stores in the Philippines, generating US$20 billion in sales. Despite their importance to the economy, these stores remain the most underserved SME segment. Lack of access and bargaining power : Sari-sari stores have no direct access to suppliers and lack teh operational know-how, leaving them with limited bargaining power, low margins (around 8%), and slow restocking/shipment of products. Solution Direct supplier link : Growsari connects sari-sari stores directly to suppliers, allowing them to earn double the margins compared to traditional supply chains. Community hub expansion : The platform enables sari-sari store owners to offer ancillary services like bill payments, e-commerce drop-off points, advertising media
